purpose: Fixed preferred primary and standby; automatic 3-hour failover per cycle with one-writer protection and automatic opportunity for recovered primary to resume.
reason: ChatGPT monitor stopped (weekly ChatGPT limit); owner made the Claude monitor primary and ChatGPT the standby.
switch_command: Owner says 'основной монитор — Claude' or 'основной монитор — ChatGPT'. Any agent then swaps primary/standby, sets set_at to the real time, commits this file.
rules: Before any write each monitor runs: python3 scripts/monitor_role.py . --me <claude|chatgpt>.
run -> full cycle as primary; failover -> full cycle, cycle note says 'failover for <primary>'; skip -> no writes at all.

Automatic per-cycle failover: after 180 minutes without a verified completed primary cycle, the enabled standby may take over, subject to the 50-minute collision guard. On primary recovery the standby skips; no owner command is needed for per-cycle failover.
Nobody writes if the other monitor committed within collision_guard_minutes.
Roles never change automatically; failover is per cycle. Only the owner switches primary.

Owner approval is needed only to change the preferred named primary/standby designation, NOT for automatic failover or automatic return after recovery. Failover cannot start a disabled or rate-limited scheduler.

When the standby has just completed a failover cycle, it yields the next hourly slot for 100 minutes so the preferred primary can recover and resume; after that, it may continue failover if primary remains silent. Do not count standby cycles as evidence that primary recovered.
